text.card: A red giant 1,892 parsecs away, 7 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 4, give 1.36 solar masses and 6.6 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 5,093 K at its surface.
